Uncredited (others) }} '''Thaddeus' minions''' are a group of characters {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== The minions are five [[Aspirant (TV series)|aspirants]] in the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] chapter known as the [[Knights of San Fernando]]. They are a gang of bullies led by [[Thaddeus]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The End (episode)|The End]]=== Together with Thaddeus, they beat up [[Maximus]], fleeing only when spotted by a cleric. ==Appearances== Thaddeus' minions appear only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|1=101}} ==Behind the scenes== Of the five minions, only one is played by a credited actor with a speaking role ([[Dorsey Williams]]). Two others are played by stunt performers [[Panda Pryor]] and [[Jeremy Sample]].
